payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of the three layers of the annotation scheme used in the OLID dataset.

claims.text: The three layers of the annotation scheme are: (A) whether language is offensive or not, (B) the type of offensive language, and (C) the target of the offensive language.
Layer A categorizes language as offensive (OFF) or not (NOT).
Layer B identifies the type of offensive language, such as profanity, insult, or abuse.
Layer C categorizes the targets of offensive language as individual (IND), group (GRP), or other (OTH).
